latest_release.name: v0.3.2
latest_release.body:
OpenFilm 0.3.2 improves project switching on Windows, brings more of the edit across to other editors, and makes the canvas and asset library work together.

**Projects and workspace.** Open and switch project tabs more reliably on Windows. Duplicate a project from its menu, or reference media on a network share that disallows system links. The chat divider resizes the workspace and asset drawer together, and the inspector scrolls with a trackpad.

**Canvas and timeline.** Canvas writing nodes take text, image and video references. Videos rest on their opening frame, play on hover and can give you a still. Show in Assets finds the matching file and briefly highlights it. Organize compatible tracks with undo, select ranges of layers, and see mixed audio waveforms on compound clips.

**Editing-project exports.** Exports keep effects and visible subtitles automatically. Reference the original files or copy complete sources. Jianying and CapCut retain subtitle styling, and supported Jianying clip settings stay editable.

**Assets and services.** Large projects load visible thumbnails first. Library previews can be retried, and a paused viewer redraws when its images finish loading. Canvas model choices update as soon as a service connects. TBC mischief 1 and Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite are available with your OpenRouter key.

Check for updates in the desktop app or use the installers below. CLI users can run `npm i -g openfilm`.

Thanks to @yunloong-Y and @WEBGRS for their pull requests in this release.

### Patch Changes

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Bring the destination project forward when switching tabs or opening a project from the plus button on Windows. The Projects menu can duplicate the current edit into an independent project in the same group.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Reference original files and folders on Windows network shares that refuse system links. The references work for previews and exports.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Refresh open timelines after changes outside the editor, retry failed reads, and keep newer edits when an older response arrives late. The canvas and edit retain separate panel sizes.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Keep the asset drawer and workspace aligned when dragging the chat divider. Constrain the inspector so the properties scroll while the tabs stay in place.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Add text, pictures and videos as writing-node references. Canvas videos show the first frame at rest, play on hover, and can be renamed or captured as stills. Imported nodes register their connection handles as soon as the upload finishes.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Refresh canvas generation models when media settings change or a browser sign-in completes. Show in Assets scrolls to the matching card and briefly highlights it.
